summary.text: Christine Drazan is an Oregon state senator and the 2022 Republican nominee for governor, who lost narrowly to Tina Kotek. She served in the Oregon House from 2019 to 2022, including as Minority Leader, and returned as Minority Leader in 2025 before being appointed to the Senate. Her campaign stresses cutting taxes, loosening building and land-use rules, and steering people experiencing homelessness into treatment.

paragraphs.text: Born in Klamath Falls and raised in Southern Oregon; graduated from George Fox University and worked as communications director for House Speaker Mark Simmons in the 1990s.
Elected to the Oregon House in 2018; served as House Republican leader 2019 to 2021 and again in 2025.
Appointed to the Oregon Senate in October 2025 to fill the District 26 vacancy left by Daniel Bonham, and announced her 2026 campaign days later.
